title: Confidence Calibration
description: Predicted probabilities match true frequencies; the calibration is measured. Honesty gets numeric. Trust gets earned.

demo.code:
print("ECE: 0.03 (calibrated!)")
print("90% confident: right 90% (honest!)")
conf, correct = 0.85, True
print("stated confidence: %.0f%%" % (100 * conf))
print("outcome correct:", correct)
print("honest" if (conf > 0.5) == correct else "miscalibrated")

title: Temperature Scaling
description: A single temperature parameter calibrates logits; the fix is simple. Simplicity gets effective. Calibration gets cheap.

demo.code:
print("T=1.5: ECE 0.12 -> 0.04 (simple!)")
print("cheap: one parameter")
bins = [(0.9, 9, 10), (0.7, 6, 10)]
for c, hit, n in bins:
    print("bin %.1f: empirical %.2f" % (c, hit / n))
print("ECE approx: %.3f" % (sum(abs(c - hit / n) for c, hit, n in bins) / len(bins)))
print("calibration measured")

title: Uncertainty Quantification
description: Models report uncertainty, not just answers; the unknown is named. Naming gets honest. Decisions get informed.

demo.code:
print("uncertain: 30% (named!)")
print("decision: defer (informed!)")
uncertain = 0.32
threshold = 0.5
print("uncertainty: %.2f" % uncertain)
print("abstain:", uncertain > threshold)
assert 0.0 <= uncertain <= 1.0
print("uncertainty in range")

title: Selective Prediction
description: Models abstain when uncertain; the abstention is wise. Wisdom gets selective. Errors get avoided.

demo.code:
print("abstained: 10% (wisely!)")
print("avoided: 90% of errors")
claimed, observed = 0.8, 0.78
gap = abs(claimed - observed)
print("claimed %.2f observed %.2f gap %.3f" % (claimed, observed, gap))
print("well calibrated:", gap < 0.05)
assert gap < 0.1
print("check passed")
